method: Fresh processes, variants/cases reversed every second round, all production extensions enabled. Ordinary archives compare parse time; diagnostic clocks perturb individual-text timings. Candidate consolidate includes fused email processing; autolink_text is a subset, never add it again. Baseline postprocess includes another consolidation, text processing and traversal. Literal ownership preserved, no deferred get_literal allocation. Generation/fingerprints/HTML/release excluded; release and OS memory separately sampled. Not GUI latency.

ast_preparation.method: Same EXE, baseline/candidate Core DLLs, fresh processes in interleaved/reversed order. Synchronous DocumentSession preparation, coarse parser metrics, no per-inline logging. Construction/workload generation, node census and destruction excluded from wall_ms. Detail samples separately add fine clocks and counts. Not GUI latency.
